title: The first Reeve's shade names four ways to resolve the Hollow Throne ('fill it, burn it, sit in it, or read the truth aloud'), but the throne room itself only ever offered two as selectable menu options (burn, via oil the Regent supplies; kneel/sit). 'Fill it' and 'read the truth aloud' were never offered there, and unlike every other locked path in the game (which states 'locked: do X, or Y'), nothing in the throne room said what those two required - reaching 'truth' apparently needed the Founding Ledger fetched earlier from the Hall of Ledgers, with no pointer back to that from the throne.
